name: Fuencemillán (Spain)
description: Gyronny of twelve pieces of yellow and black, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuencemillán (crossed shotguns on yellow).
history: The arms of Fuencemillán were approved in 1987 and the flag most recently in 2007, published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 20 April 2007; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, gyronny of twelve pieces of yellow and black, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre. The crossed shotguns are a traditional symbol of the municipality.

features.role: gyronny of twelve pieces radiating from the centre
